item.title: High Street Streetscape Final Update - Nov. 24, 2020
item.description:
High Street Streetscape Final Update -

Nov. 24, 2020

Construction Update

Final Update Notice

The High Street Streetscape Improvements project is near its final completion. The team will conduct minor touch-up work ensuring there are no cracks in the curb or sidewalks, and electrical crews will remain on site working to finish traffic signals and other miscellaneous electrical items. All of this work will be completed by the end of the year.

This construction update will serve as the last update sent out in this form. In the event that questions or comments arise regarding this project, please contact 311, the City of Columbus Service Center. You may either call (614) 645-3111 or visit https://311.columbus.gov/.

item.title: High Street Streetscape Update - Nov. 13, 2020
item.description:
High Street Streetscape Update -

Nov. 13, 2020

Construction Update

Final Updates Notice

As the High Street Streetscape Improvements project nears final completion, this construction update will serve as the second-to-last update sent out in this form. In the event that questions or comments arise, please contact 311, the City of Columbus Service Center. You may either call (614) 645-3111 or visit https://311.columbus.gov/.

Progress Update

Over the next couple of weeks, crews will be making improvements to sidewalks where they have cracked or have been damaged through the project area. Next week, crews will continue working to wash and seal new sidewalks on the east side of High St. working northbound. Crews are also continuing to install new site amenities, including trash and recycling receptacles, bike racks and trees in the grates. Electrical crews will continue work to install new traffic signals at the intersections of High St. and King Ave., High St. and W. Fifth Ave. and High St. and W. Fourth Ave. Short-term traffic shifts may occur due to the installation of traffic signals over the roadway.

COTA Stops

  • Southbound stop at High St. and Clark Pl. is permanently installed at 1301 N. High St.
  • Northbound stop at High St. and E. Sixth Ave. is permanently installed at 1350 N. High St.
  • Northbound stop at High St. and E. Fifth Ave. is permanently installed at 1244 N. High St.
  • Southbound stop at High St and W. Fifth Ave. is permanently installed at 1195 N. High St.
  • Southbound stop at High St. and W. Fourth Ave. is permanently installed at 1101 N. High St.
  • Northbound stop at High St. and E. Second Ave. is permanently installed at 1020 N. High St.

COTA is assessing and directing the transit service needs of the community as changes occur daily. Increased cleaning and disinfecting in shelters and buses will continue, and COTA strongly encourages physical distancing, use of the hand sanitizer provided on buses and for riders to wear masks. COTA requests that customers limit non-essential bus travel until further notice. For the most up-to-date information, please call COTA’s customer service center at 614-228-1776 or visit: www.cota.com/rider-service-alerts.

Weather

Temperatures are forecasted with highs in the 60s and lows in the 30s, with little chance of rain expected throughout the week. All of the work being conducted is weather dependent. The schedule is subject to change in the event of extensive rain, temperatures consistently below 40 degrees or potential crew member illness.

item.title: High St. Streetscape Update - Arch Lighting Replacement Starts Soon
item.description:
High Street Streetscape Update -

July 27, 2020

Arch Lighting Replacement Starts Soon

From Poplar Ave. to Smith Pl.

Beginning next month, crews will start replacing the North High Street arch lighting system. The current system of 17 arches and 859 bulbs was installed in 2006. Maintenance has been performed over the years, but the system has aged and it is now time to replace it.

The arch lights will be replaced with a modern LED lighting system using the same arch structures. The new system will produce light shows like the old system and will  be built with improved components. The Short North Special Improvement District will be assuming the day-to-day maintenance operations of the lighting system, including bulb maintenance and light shows. This work is being performed with existing funds from the High Street Streetscape Improvements Project along with funding from the Short North Special Improvement District. 

Expect the arch lighting to be off (de-energized) when construction is active. Work is tentatively planned to start the week of August 10. Watch weekly construction updates for impact and progress information.
